producer_report.summary: Added an optional `mirrored_sources` section to the job plan, plus a tested admission rule and planner and critic prompt rules. A plan that writes content mirroring a governing source now has to name the source, list every place in it the content depends on, and point at a criterion that compares the content to those places. Admission refuses an entry with a blank content or source, no non-blank place, or a comparison criterion outside 1..criteria; each is one major finding at `mirrored sources, entry N`, and the plan goes back to the planner with no critic call. An empty or missing section gives no finding, so old records parse and re-serialise unchanged. Admission checks shape only. Whether the list is complete, and whether the comparing demonstration checks content rather than structure, is the critic's own search and is marked prose-only in the prompts, design doc and CHANGELOG, so the shape rule is not read as closing f62n. The section is stored on `JobPlan`, shown in `plan_body` only when non-empty, and carried through the planner output schema and the output-to-record conversion. Tests: unit tests in admission.rs, an eight-case corpus table, a records round-trip, a schema test, a briefs rendering test and an end-to-end job test where the incomplete plan is sent back and the complete one lands. The planner and critic budget lines in docs/system-facts.md are updated to 1024 and 1014.

A planner that mirrors a source but gives an empty `mirrored_sources` is caught only by the critic prompt, which is prose-only. The CHANGELOG, the design doc and both prompts say so.
Completeness of the places list and structure-only comparisons are not checked by Athena. Admission checks only shape.

mistakes: I first wrote the banned word `lease` in a corpus fixture string. I reworded it to `the definition of a term in the brief and docs` before running the policy scan, which passes.
My first planner bullet was about 390 bytes, well over the 179 bytes of room. I shortened it and trimmed words elsewhere in planner.md until the file was 2092 bytes.

I ran the background full suite and several foreground suites at once. One athena-core run exited 101 under that load, I could not see which test failed, and the rerun alone passed. I did not find the cause.
learnings: The `estimate_tokens` function is ceil(len/3), so the frame test `< 700` means a prompt file of at most 2097 bytes.
Schemars keeps doc-comment line breaks in field descriptions, so a test that searches a description for a phrase must collapse whitespace first.
Plan-body tests and the budget lines in docs/system-facts.md are coupled: any change to planner.md or critic.md needs the two `budget` lines updated (system_facts_budgets_match_computed).
`JobPlan` has no `Default`, so a new field needs `mirrored_sources: vec![]` in every struct literal (store, status, run_pin_tests, reading, briefs, admission and the corpus).
`PlanDependent` is imported in run/mod.rs and reached from planning.rs through `use super::*`, so a new record type used there must be added to the run/mod.rs import list.
desires: A way to read the output file of a background command inside the working directory, so a long suite can run without a timeout.
